entities.summary: Akhra (Ahrik) Ruslanovich Avidzba better known by his call sign "Abkhaz" (Абхаз) is a political activist of the partially recognized Republic of Abkhazia, a participant in the war in Donbass on the side of Russian-controlled separatists, commander of the international brigade "Pyatnashka". He participated in the political crisis in Abkhazia in 2020, which ended with the resignation of Abkhazian president Khajimba.
